## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A three-fascicle alternative recension of Asaṅga's *Vajracchedikā-vyākhyā*, the doublet companion of [T1510a](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0030). The Taishō head-note records the alternative title 「亦名金剛能斷般若」 ("also named the *Vajra-Able-to-Cut Prajñā*"). The opening *praṇāma*-verse is identical to T1510a, indicating the same translation in different textual transmission. Signature: 「無著菩薩造／隋南天竺三藏法師達摩岌多譯」 (with the alternative transliteration 達摩岌多 for the translator's name).

**Abstract**

T1510b is a parallel-recension transmission of Dharmagupta's translation of Asaṅga's *Vajracchedikā-vyākhyā*. The two recensions T1510a and T1510b reflect different states of the same Indic source and the same Chinese translation; the three-fascicle T1510b is somewhat more expanded.
